faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Quickly find answers to your questions about travelling to Benin

notfound.title: Didn't find your answer?
notfound.text: Our team is here to help. Contact us by email, phone or through our form.

questions.q: What is the best time to visit Benin?
questions.a: The best time runs from November to March, during the dry season. Temperatures are pleasant (25-32°C) and the roads are passable. It is also the ideal period for safaris in Pendjari National Park.

questions.q: Do I need a visa to enter Benin?
questions.a: Yes, a visa is required for most nationalities. You can get it online through the e-Visa system (https://evisa.gouv.bj) or on arrival at Cotonou airport. The tourist visa costs about €50 for 30 days.
Yellow fever vaccination is mandatory. Recommended vaccines include hepatitis A and B, typhoid, meningitis and rabies. Antimalarial treatment is strongly advised.

questions.q: What is the currency in Benin?
questions.a: The currency is the CFA franc (XOF). €1 ≈ 655 FCFA. Bank cards are accepted in large hotels, but it is best to carry cash in rural areas.

questions.q: Which languages are spoken in Benin?
questions.a: French is the official language. The most widely spoken local languages are Fon, Yoruba, Aja and Bariba. English is also understood in tourist areas.

questions.q: How do I book a tour with LEGBAH?
questions.a: You can book directly on our website by choosing your tour and dates, or contact us through the contact form for a personalised quote. A 30% deposit is required at booking.

questions.q: Can I change or cancel my booking?
questions.a: Yes, changes are possible subject to availability. For cancellations: more than 60 days before departure: full refund; 30-60 days: 50% retained; less than 30 days: non-refundable.

questions.q: Do you offer tours for groups?
questions.a: Absolutely! We organise tours for groups of any size: families, associations, companies. Discounted rates apply from 6 people.

questions.q: Do the prices include international flights?
questions.a: Our tours do not usually include international flights, unless stated otherwise. However, we can advise you on the best flight options.

questions.q: How do I get around in Benin?
questions.a: For organised tours, we provide private air-conditioned vehicles with a driver-guide. For independent travellers, options include motorbike taxis (zémidjans), shared taxis, buses, and car rental with a driver.

questions.q: What types of accommodation do you offer?
questions.a: We select quality accommodation: 3-4 star hotels in Cotonou, comfortable lodges near the parks, authentic guesthouses, and sometimes homestays.
Yes, we select trusted restaurants. We recommend drinking bottled water and avoiding unwashed raw vegetables and ice cubes.
4G is available in the main cities. We provide a local SIM card with data to all our travellers. WiFi is available in most hotels.

questions.q: What should I do in an emergency?
questions.a: We provide 24/7 assistance with a local emergency number. Our on-site team can help you if there is a problem. Also keep your embassy's contact details with you.
